pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No adaptive-analysis or holdout-validity concept exists.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: The foundational result that adaptive reuse of a dataset invalidates classical inference guarantees, and that privacy-style perturbation restores them — the theory underneath every reusable-holdout design.

actionability.rationale: Abstract-level: the mechanism is named (perturb and coordinate estimates) but not procedural in the note.
